caption: Tivoli Gardens, Copenhagen
composition: Closed garden gate and dark trees on Vesterbrogade · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Vesterbrogade sidewalk, Tivoli's brick Hovedindgang is shut: pavilion wings, a multicoloured tiled dome, gold TIVOLI lettering, and festoon lights, with dark trees behind the gates. The pavement is empty under ordinary streetlamps. It is a mainly clear night, about 13.9°C, with no rain. Summer at Tivoli ended on 20 September 2026 and Halloween does not open until 2 October, so this is not a ride night, a flower show, or a Halloween display.
